notes:
Venture 0.21 — compass calibration you can trust, height above the ground, and a brightness control

• A calibration the aircraft never heard used to wait for ever on a zero, with only CANCEL to press. START is now repeated until the aircraft answers, and the screen says which happened: no reply, refused, or accepted and then silent.

• The big number during a calibration is the percentage, not the count of covered patches. The aircraft finishes on the percentage and does not need all 80 patches filled, so the last few are not worth turning for.

• The result shows what the aircraft was calibrated to before, beside what this run would write — offsets, scale and orientation — so you can see how far it moves before keeping it. ACCEPT is now SAVE.

• A save is confirmed by the aircraft and then read back off it. The old one was sent once and said "saved" either way, so a calibration could look written while the aircraft kept its old numbers.

• REBOOT is on the same screen once a calibration is saved. The new offsets are live immediately, but the aircraft navigates on the old ones until it restarts.

• ALT on the flight screen is now height above the ground whenever the aircraft can report it. On a terrain mission it used to show height above the launch point, which is never the height the mission was planned at — over ground 40 m higher than launch, a mission flown at 60 m read 100.

• Saving any mission now downloads the ground elevations for its area, not just terrain-following ones. That is what lets the aircraft report its height above ground, use its terrain failsafe, and return home at a terrain altitude. If the aircraft has terrain switched off, the flight screen's status log says so.

• Screen brightness: Configuration > Controller > SCREEN. Ten steps, the screen follows the slider, and it stays where you put it. Dim it to save the controller's battery on a long survey, or run it bright in sun.

• The controller no longer claims an aircraft that has stopped talking. If the flight controller goes quiet while the rest of the aircraft keeps transmitting, FLY and COMPASS grey out instead of offering a link with nothing behind it.

• The cards on the home screen are the size of the cards everywhere else.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
